description: Drive WPS Presentation via Kwpp.Application COM. Narrative layouts: timeline, comparison, thesis-chain, argument, thesis-vertical (3-step), SWOT 2×2. Prefer tools/wps_dispatch.ps1 -Action run-spec.

actions.name: new
actions.description: Create a new presentation, save to output, bind session

actions.name: add-slide
actions.description: Append slide; layout: title | title-content | section | two-content | blank

actions.name: set-text
actions.description: Set title / subtitle / bullets on slide (1-based index)

actions.name: insert-image
actions.description: Insert picture on slide; optional left top width height

actions.name: close
actions.description: Close active presentation; save? default true

actions.name: run-spec
actions.description: Build full deck from JSON spec file or inline spec; validates unless skipValidation true

actions.name: compile-dsl
actions.description: Compile high-level PPT DSL to a renderer plan or legacy spec without starting WPS

actions.name: run-dsl
actions.description: Build full deck from high-level PPT DSL through RenderPlan and WPS COM

actions.name: validate-spec
actions.description: Validate spec JSON structure (no WPS); returns errors array on failure

actions.name: doctor
actions.description: Health check: paths, session, COM ProgID registry; set comProbe true to try live WPS

actions.name: exec
actions.description: Dot-source a .ps1 under project root only (scriptPath relative)
